name: Sun Stride frees the caster from roots and slows and boosts speed (#2211)
contract: Sun Stride 680700 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 33, RecoveryTime 24000) carries SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY (77) twice, with EffectMiscValue 7 (MECHANIC_ROOT) and 11 (MECHANIC_SNARE), plus SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED (31) with EffectBasePoints 149 resolving to +150 (percent). Its AttributesEx carries SPELL_ATTR1_IMMUNITY_PURGES_EFFECT (0x8000, value 32768). SpellInfo::ApplyAllSpellImmunitiesTo (SpellInfo.cpp), invoked from AuraEffect::HandleModMechanicImmunity on every mechanic-immunity aura apply, calls target->RemoveAurasWithMechanic(mechanicImmunity, ...) whenever that attribute is set -- so casting Sun Stride purges any currently-applied root or snare, not merely blocking new ones, with no script needed. Frost Nova (122, EffectMechanic word for effect 1 = 7/ROOT) and Hamstring (1715, EffectMechanic for effect 0 = 11/SNARE) are used here only as real, DBC-verified root/snare fixtures, unrelated to their normal casters.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Sun Stride purges the fixture root
Sun Stride purges the fixture snare
Sun Stride raises run speed to 2.5x
